obligations.note: The change names ticket CHG-26979, a standard ticket approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-14, before the change was opened. Its components (mortgage.servicing, mortgage.tests) cover both touched paths: RateQuote.java and the mortgage test file.
The code_review approval comes from Declan Farrell, who holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author Wen Li under all of Wen Li's listed addresses.

The approval names commit a557021. The later commit 06b0de9 ('Comment the rate sheet terms') is consistent with the base..head diff, where the only content beyond the approved helper and its test is comment text, so the approval carries forward.

run.json claims a ci-runner-05 run on head 06b0de9 starting 2026-10-16. The JUnit reports it cites were instead produced on a personal machine (dev-laptop-7.local) with timestamps of 2026-10-23, after the 2026-10-19 review time. The reports therefore do not belong to the change's CI run, and there is no valid evidence of the full suite passing on the final commit.

summary: PR-1236 adds a small RateQuote.isSupportedTerm helper and a unit test. Neither file is in the scope of any product obligation, and none is security-sensitive or protected. The ticket, the independent code review and the carry-forward of that approval over a comment-only follow-up commit are adequately evidenced. However, the test reports attached to the CI record come from a developer workstation and are dated after the review time, so they cannot be the change's own CI run on the final commit. Because the CHG-4 testing evidence is invalid, the change is rejected until a genuine CI run on 06b0de9 is supplied.
